name: Case for Thomas at Initech is reopened and routed to Michael in the right group
description: Case for Thomas at Initech is reopened and routed to Michael in the right group

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN account a ON cc.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN contact c ON cc.contact_id = c.contact_id
JOIN "user" u ON cc.assigned_to = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON cc.assignment_group_id = g.group_id
WHERE a.name = 'Initech'
  AND u.first_name = 'Michael'
  AND u.last_name = 'Lee'
  AND g.name = 'CSM Tier 1 Support'
  AND cc.state = 'in_progress'
  AND cc.reopen_count >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM case_knowledge ck
JOIN customer_case cc ON ck.case_id = cc.case_id
JOIN account a ON cc.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.name = 'Initech'
  AND ck.used_as = 'resolution'
  AND ck.knowledge_id = 46;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM case_knowledge ck
JOIN customer_case cc ON ck.case_id = cc.case_id
JOIN account a ON cc.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.name = 'Initech'
  AND ck.used_as = 'suggested'
  AND ck.knowledge_id = 170;
